scope: Distinct named GDI32.dll imports in PE files under test/binaries.

metafile: WMF/EMF recording and playback preserve valid object/byte contracts but do not capture or replay drawing records
GetWinMetaFileBits and SetWinMetaFileBits emit valid empty target streams rather than converting drawing records
format: BI_BITFIELDS and correct 16-bpp BI_RGB 5-5-5 DIB creation
visibility: Derived system/window visibility clipping is not part of the explicit app clip
presentation: SetDeviceGammaRamp state round-trips but the LUT is not applied by the browser compositor
Pixel-format APIs expose one software RGBA format; OpenGL command rendering is outside GDI
fontPolicy: AddFontResourceA installs user-supplied NE .FON or standalone FNT 2.x/3.x bitmap strikes from the VFS; RemoveFontResourceA unregisters them
CreateFont selects installed bitmap faces by name and TextOut uses their one-bit glyphs and metrics; unsupported formats and text paths retain deterministic CSS fallbacks
GetFontData returns GDI_ERROR because Canvas does not expose selected font tables
GetGlyphOutlineA supports GGO_METRICS; outline and bitmap payload formats remain unavailable
EnumFontsA shares the current deterministic single-face fallback enumeration
